column3: “according to what each man should eat” renders “according to the mouth of his eating,” and “divide” renders “count (estimate).”
“a year old” renders “son of a year.”
“no plague will befall you to destroy you” renders “there will be no plague among you for destruction.”
“a permanent ordinance” renders “a statute of perpetuity.”
“the Feast of Unleavened Bread” renders “the unleavened bread”; “on this very day” renders “on the bone (substance) of this day.”
“Go” renders “draw out”; “lambs” renders “flock,” and “the Passover lamb” renders “the passover.”
“spared our homes” renders “delivered our houses”; “the Egyptians” renders “Egypt.”
“the dungeon” renders “the house of the pit.”
